description: This file contains the PHP class Opencart\Admin\Controller\Mail\Authorize which extends the base Controller class and handles email authorization and reset functionalities within the OpenCart admin panel. It manages email sending, reset and confirmation processes, and interacts with configuration, session, and mail libraries.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: This class manages email authorization, reset, and confirmation processes in the OpenCart admin area. It sends emails with authorization and reset links, and interacts with email, session, and configuration components.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the email authorization process by sending authorization emails if conditions are met, such as route and email validity.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Handles the password reset process by sending reset emails containing confirmation links if valid email and code are provided.
